scenario_description:
Objective: Preserve the next-morning SFO loan escort departure while retaining the booked PDX flight and receiving appointment.
Emerging Need: A routine sealed-case itinerary becomes risky only after PDX posts a first-wave oversize lane-sharing advisory with a same-day prelist window.
Decision Context: The useful response depends on stored case dimensions and secure oversize-desk messaging rules, plus the active flight code, not on the public advisory alone.
Consequence: Once the prelist exports, the trip can still proceed, but screening may fall to the general oversize queue and erode the boarding buffer.

parameter.title: SFO Legion loan escort receiving appointment
parameter.description: Courier receiving appointment after the first PDX-SFO flight; arrive with sealed portfolio case and travel packet.
parameter.location: Legion of Honor secure receiving entrance, San Francisco

parameter.subject: PDX-SFO reservation LK7M2Q for September 15
parameter.body: Reservation LK7M2Q is held for AS1845, Portland to San Francisco, departing 06:15 on September 15 and arriving 08:05. One passenger seat is confirmed for the courier escort. Standard terminal check-in opens at 04:30; no checkpoint advisory is attached to this itinerary notice.

parameter.description: Special-item handling payment for AS1845 PDX-SFO courier escort.

parameter.content: PDX first-wave notice for Tuesday 04:00-07:00: east checkpoint oversize inspection will share one table during construction. Prelisted sealed courier cases may use the west oversize lane. Prelist entries close at 18:00 today; general oversize screening remains available tomorrow morning.

parameter.subject: PDX west oversize prelist exported for September 15 first wave
parameter.body: The 18:00 export for Tuesday first-wave west oversize lane prelisted courier cases is complete. No additional sealed-case entries can be added for 04:00-07:00. Travelers not on the list should use the general oversize queue when airline counters open.
